assertion_note: No added assertion compares a value against the same variable the test passed in. The head count is measured by a stand-in that counts its own walks; the liveness readings are taken through recovery_liveness.local_liveness against a live child the test starts, so they fail if the environment scan does not consult the table; the base count is produced by neutralising the region and re-running the pass.

assertion_review.failure_condition: If the environment scan did not consult the walk map, the live child's mark would not read alive or a markless pointer would not read dead, and the positive control fails before either count is believed.
Removing the region from reckon/crew/station_store.py:874 reinstates the per-pointer walk and this reads 40, exactly as negative-control.log records at the base revision.
If the region changed a verdict, the head arm's classification would differ from the neutralised base arm's and the equality fails; the live-carrier rows at :341-346 keep the comparison non-vacuous.
If the fixture stopped reaching the environment scan, the base arm would walk fewer than 40 times and the negative control would no longer reproduce the defect.
